narratives.Description: 0.130.1: consumer setup fixes (hook rewrite, forward-coverage warn-only, getting-started order, runtime gitignore)
narratives.Overview:
Four consumer-setup fixes for 0.130.1, before 0.130.x is promoted to npm `latest`. Each one is described in its own issue: #6806, #6807, #6800 and #6795.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Setup writes `.githooks/*` replacements to a temp file in the same directory and renames it over the target, so a shell already running the old hook keeps reading the old file (#6806).
- [ ] A test runs the old pre-commit body under bash while self-complete replaces the hooks, and the commit succeeds (#6806).
- [ ] The deposited `pre-commit` runs forward coverage warn-only: a missing paired test prints the finding and does not fail the commit. CI and `deft check` behaviour is unchanged (#6807).
- [ ] The setup hook-body test pins the warn-only forward-coverage form (#6807).
- [ ] `content/docs/getting-started.md`, and any setup skill text with the same order, has the first-project path create the feature branch before the deposit commit (#6800).
- [ ] The deposited consumer `.gitignore` ignores Directive runtime state under `.deft/` and `.deft-cache/`, while keeping `.deft/approved-scope/` and `.deft/intent-constraint/` trackable (#6795).
- [ ] A test shows that after `session:start` in a fresh install, `git status --porcelain` lists no Directive runtime file (#6795).
- [ ] One CHANGELOG fragment covers the four consumer-facing changes.

Refs #6806, #6807, #6800, #6795
